notes.title: Dig Dig Boom is a charming looking turn-based puzzle mining roguelike
notes.notes:
Turn-based puzzle mining in a highly dynamic destructible world, Dig Dig Boom looks like a charming game you should stick on your wishlist.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/12/dig-dig-boom-is-a-charming-looking-turn-based-puzzle-mining-roguelike
